text.p: Trinity Industries Inc said Tuesday Alvin Holland has been named chief financial officer.
The company did not say whom Holland replaced and a spokesman for the company was not immediately available.
In addition, the company said that Michael Fortado has been named vice president, corporate secretary and general counsel.
Most recently, Holland served as president of First Dallas Group, a financial services and consulting firm.
Most recently, Fortado was senior vice president, general counsel and corporate secretary for Enserch Exploration Inc .
Trinity is a diversified industrial manufacturers, operating principally in transportation products, construction products and industrial products.
